fusions.name: Grapnel Bite
fusions.desc: Throws a toothed grapnel into the first enemy within 6 tiles for 13 damage. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Inescapable] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Turn Turtle
fusions.desc: Rolls over everything within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage to every enemy there and leaving each [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Waiting on the Tide
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second wait, increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Drift Log

riders.text: and most of you is under it when the blow comes
you drift over it faster than over ground
and you mend while you lie in it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank your dodge chance rises by 6% on it, from silver you move 10% faster on it, and from gold your health recovers 20% faster on it.
